item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00276","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C08","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.87,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C18 plausibly supplied the core condolence-cable template: formal address to a foreign head of state followed by sorrow language and an expression, on behalf of the American people, of deep sympathy to the addressee and affected people. C15 concerns foreign suffering and American solidarity but lacks the child's concise condolence formula.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"On behalf of the Government and people of the United States, I wish to convey to Your Excellency's Government and to the people of Honduras, the deep sense of grief","parent_excerpt":"On behalf of the American people I send deepest sympathy to Your Excellency and to all those who are suffering in this disaster.","explanation":"Both use the same compact diplomatic machinery: speaking on behalf of Americans, addressing a foreign leader as “Your Excellency,” and extending deep condolence to the leader and affected people."},{"child_excerpt":"the deep sense of grief which the passing of your Ambassador ... has occasioned","parent_excerpt":"News of the tragic consequences ... has been received with sorrow and concern throughout the United States.","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's national-sorrow predicate from a disaster to the death of an ambassador."}]}
